title: Global weak solutions of a one-sided degenerate Cahn-Hilliard model for traction-driven digit morphogenesis
summary: We study a one-sided degenerate Cahn-Hilliard equation with anisotropic traction flux, arising as a reduced continuum description of mechanically biased cell interactions in digit-forming organoids. The equation combines a one-sided degenerate mobility with a density-weighted anisotropic higher-order transport term. This traction term is not generated by the variational derivative of the Cahn-Hilliard energy and therefore produces sign-indefinite contributions in the energy balance.
